referenceFunction.generalComment:
1 kg H2 produced using a SOEC electrolyzer, with steam input, powered by Swiss grid electricity. Source: Niklas Gerloff, Comparative Life-Cycle-Assessment analysis of three major water electrolysis technologies while applying various energy scenarios for a greener hydrogen production, Journal of Energy Storage, Volume 43, 2021, https://doi.org/10.1/j.est0.20.1. Stack lifetime of 20'000 hours over 2.5 years. Further refined (with respect to stack and system lifetime and water use, notably) from data from manufacturer's specifications and IndWEDe project report (https://www.now-gmbh.de/wp-content/uploads/2020/09/181127_bro_a4_indwede-studie_kurzfassung_de_v03.pdf). For further secifications (e.g., efficiency, lifetime, etc.), refer to Sacchi, R. and Bauer, C. LCA of Power-to-X processes and applications in the residential sector. Paul Scherrer Institut, 2023. Stack lifetime [hours] 20'000: IndWEDe Stack lifetime [years] 2.5: IndWEDe, based on the lower estimate of 8,000 hours per year, from manufacturers' data. Balance of Plant lifetime [years]: Same as system. System lifetime [years] 20: IndWEDe Stack replacement over system's lifetime, excluding initial unit [unit]: 7 Calculated.
